definitions.explanation: Attached to a noun to mean that something is mixed or streaked with it: {白髪|しらが}{交|ま}じり "graying," {雨|あめ}{交|ま}じり "with rain mixed in."

examples.japanese: ⟦{白髪|しらが}→白髪：00369_shiraga⟧{交|ま}じり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ため{息|いき}{交|ま}じり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧だ」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧つぶやいた。
examples.english: With a sigh, he muttered, "I can't do it anymore."

notes:
From the verb {交|ま}じる (to be mixed). Before a noun it takes ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧; as an adverb, ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{白髪|しらが}→白髪：00369_shiraga⟧{交|ま}じり: graying, salt-and-pepper (hair)
- ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧{交|ま}じり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧: rain mixed with snow, sleet
- ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧{交|ま}じり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: half jokingly
- ため{息|いき}{交|ま}じり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: with a sigh

WRITING:
Also written ⟦{混|ま}じり→混じる：02421_majiru⟧, especially for things physically mixed ({砂混|すなま}じり). {交|ま}じり is usual when the parts stay distinct (⟦{白髪|しらが}→白髪：00369_shiraga⟧{交|ま}じり, ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧{仮名|かな}{交|ま}じり⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧).
